description: This file defines an abstract class 'SimpleMapOperation' used in the OFBiz framework's minilang module. It manages operations on fields, including handling error messages and localization, and declares an abstract 'exec' method for subclasses to implement specific behavior.

classes.name: SimpleMapOperation
classes.description: An abstract class representing a single operation on a field within the OFBiz minilang framework, handling message generation and localization.

methods.name: SimpleMapOperation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML element configuration and the parent process.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field this operation targets.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds an error or status message to the provided list, supporting localization and property-based messages.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the operation, to be implemented by subclasses.
